 ☐ Git

What should happen with git when the clear command is done?

❯ 1. Commit locally (Recommended)
     Commits the change on the current branch, nothing is pushed. Easy to undo.
  2. Leave uncommitted
     Files are changed in your working tree only.
  3. Commit and push
     Commits and pushes to the remote; this publishes the change.
  4. Type something.
